name: uwebsockets-js-smuggling-poc
description: End-to-end HTTP request-smuggling PoC against real uWebSockets.js v20.69.0
_install: Run `npm install`. The dependency is intentionally pinned to the git TAG v20.69.0 (not master): that release publishes the prebuilt *.node binaries the loader needs (e.g. uws_linux_x64_127.node for Node 22 ABI 127). Installing from bare `uNetworking/uWebSockets.js` master has no prebuilt binary and fails at require() time. Supported: Node.js 22, 24, 26 on glibc Linux / macOS / Windows.
